text:
emily: Quick sync - spinning up a compact action tracker for the recent repeated OOMs across KV shards. Focus: profiling, soft-limits, and fragmentation signals. I'll list proposed owners and checkpoints.

ravi: I'll pick up the leak-signature profiler. Goal: lightweight periodic dumps (no more than 2% CPU overhead) with per-shard residency + free-slot hist. Target: prototype by Fri EOD.

anika: I'll implement an on-node soft cap that triggers background eviction before OOM. Proposal: soft-cap at 88% residency with a 30s smoothing window. Canary plan after Ravi's prototype shows alloc hotspots.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: soft-cap feature flagged for canary on shard-7 at 2800055575. Owner: anika.

tom: We should also surface fragmentation score per shard (occupied runs / total runs) so we can tie fragmentation to allocation failures. I'll add a metric for that.

grace: +1 on fragmentation metric. Also advocate for a recurring weekly runbook check: if any shard crosses 75% residency for 3 consecutive days, schedule a triage.

emily: Owners + milestones:
- ravi -> leak-signature profiler (proto) by 2800055920 (Fri EOD)
- anika -> soft-cap + canary by 2800055575 (canary) and rollout decision by 2800056100
- tom -> fragmentation score metric + dashboard panel by 2800055800
- grace -> weekly runbook automation & alert rule by 2800056000

ravi: Implementation notes: profiler will emit compressed summaries and top-20 callsites. Pseudocode snippet:
```
profiler.snapshot(interval=60s, sample=0.01, tags=["shard","run_count"]) -> s3://kv-leaks/${ts}.json.gz
```
I'll add per-upload manifest with shard and commit-id. Artifacts will expire after 21d.

anika: Canary config: 50% traffic on shard-7 for 2 hours, collect p95-latency, eviction-rate, and memory-residency. If eviction-rate > 5x baseline, abort and roll back.

ops-bot: alert-manager: rule created - kv_residency_warning. Conditions: residency >= 75% for 15m -> notify #eng-runtime.

tom: Dashboard panels: 1) residency heatmap by shard, 2) fragmentation score trend, 3) profiler-upload age and size. I'll also add a scatter correlating fragmentation vs GC pause.

grace: Runbook automation: I'll author a small lambda that opens a triage issue when shard residency >75% x 3d with attached top profiler artifact link.

emily: Risk / mitigations: profiler sampling can add overhead during high QPS. Ravi: please include a safety throttle (disable sampling if cpu > 70%). Anika: soft-cap must be conservative to avoid increased tail latency.

ravi: ack - will gate sampling on cpu and a dynamic QPS threshold. Also will include a "light" and "heavy" mode controlled by feature flag.

anika: We'll expose the soft-cap as a dynamic config so SRE can nudge it during incidents. Add a health check to ensure eviction background task completes within target.

tom: For long-term, we should evaluate a compacting pass on idle shards to reduce fragmentation. Adding as low-priority backlog item.

grace: Scheduling: weekly runbook review every Monday. I'll invite owners and oncall for the first two months.

emily: Next check-in: standup Friday 10am to confirm ravi prototype and tom dashboard. I'll update the postmortem actions doc with these owners and links.

ops-bot: reminder-bot: scheduled reminder for Ravi prototype @2800055920.

emily: Thanks everyone. Closing thread - tracker link: https://redwood.internal/pm/2800055555-kv-residency-playbook
